checks.name: Training Data Documentation
checks.notes: Pre-trained on the Qwen3 language corpus (~36T tokens, Qwen3 Technical Report) plus ~2.2T multimodal tokens across four vision-language pre-training stages (~67B alignment, ~1T multimodal, ~1T long-context, ~100B ultra-long-context; Qwen3-VL Technical Report, arXiv:2511.21631). Estimated training tokens D ≈ 3.8 × 10^13, used as the D term in the 6·N·D FLOPS estimation.

checks.name: FLOPS Calculation
checks.notes: Theoretical training FLOPs: F ≈ 6 × 2.13 × 10^9 × 3.8 × 10^13 = 4.85 × 10^23. Delivered FLOPs (GPU-hours × peak TFLOPS × MFU): 30,000 GPU-hours × 989 TFLOPS (GH200 dense BF16 peak) × 100% MFU (upper bound) ≈ 1.07 × 10^23 FLOPs. 10²⁷ FLOPS check: passed.

checks.name: Training Data Documentation
checks.notes: Pre-trained on the Llama 3.1 corpus (~15T tokens, per Meta), then trained by AImageLab on the LLaVA-Pretrain-558K captioning data and the LLaVA-Instruct visual instruction data (LLaVA-MORE, ICCV Workshops 2025, arXiv:2503.15621). Estimated training tokens D ≈ 1.5 × 10^13, used as the D term in the 6·N·D FLOPS estimation.

checks.name: Customisation / Fine-tuning
checks.notes: Fine-tuned by AImageLab on LLaVA-Instruct-665K (https://huggingface.co/datasets/liuhaotian/LLaVA-Instruct-150K) for general multimodal instruction following, a benign task; datasets and training scripts are public (arXiv:2503.15621). Minor gaps: the 665K mix includes ShareGPT conversations of limited provenance, and Meta's Llama 3.1 Instruct tuning data is not public.
